run_pdf_to_markdown: run nougat predict.py to convert PDF files to markdown format using the Nougat model
run_pdf_to_markdown_batch: run nougat predict.py with a directory of PDFs to batch convert all files to markdown
run_pdf_specific_pages: run nougat predict.py with --pages flag to convert only specific pages of a single PDF
run_pdf_full_precision: run nougat predict.py with --full-precision flag to use float32 instead of bfloat16 for CPU conversion
run_pdf_recompute: run nougat predict.py with --recompute flag to reconvert already processed PDFs and overwrite existing output
